formRaceEntries.comment: Has not been disgraced contesting stronger races of late. In with an each-way show despite dropping in class.
Found trouble two runs back & OK after having every chance last time. Class drop could suit here.

formRaceEntries.lastGear: Blinkers ON, Pacifiers ON, Winkers OFF

formRaceEntries.comment: Pushed forward from a tricky gate & stuck on OK at Wodonga. Drawn well & worth thought again here.
Had every chance when not disgraced at Wodonga. Each-way chance in this easier contest.
Resumes. First-up record is sound & is a winner over this course. 4th in a Pakenham jumpout 19/5. Betting?
Last in two jumpouts but ran on well when narrowly beaten her first-up. Fitter & wet ground won't worry him.
Raced wide when never a chance here last time. Back in class but up in trip for this. Doesn't want it too wet.
Improved with blinkers on when unlucky at Horsham last time. Drops in class & worth thought here.
Slow out but ran on well at Wagga second-up. FItter again & could place again despite the draw.
formRaceEntries.lastGear: Ear Muffs OFF, Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) ON, Winkers ON

formRaceEntries.comment: Debut for stable (ex A Coffey). Freshened after a fair effort at Swan Hill. Drops in class & drawn well.
Resumes for new stable, ex Mark Ashby. Unplaced in jumpouts. Won first up last time in, but at picnic level.
Disappointing at last few. Look elsewhere for the winner.
Gave too much start when jumping in class at Pakenham second-up. Fitter & this class suits.
Resumes. Is a first-up winner but mixed form last time in. 4th & 2nd in recent jumpouts. Check the betting.
